第10章 中计老子将计就计烧你爹的尸（第1页）
老丑顾不上体内伤势，轻功全开，一路疾行回木屋。
老丑一拍大腿：“大意了，大意了，没想到，今天竟被个小姑娘耍了！“
随即自嘲冷笑：“马映雪，你还真是让我意外。竟聪慧至此。“
老丑心中推测，马映雪带着一人，应该没能走远。现下正是追赶的最后机会！
走出竹屋，左右查探。刚迈出几步，便觉不妥，眉头轻皱。
目下没有丝毫线索，这四面八方，哪能追上？
“马映雪，你好一招调虎离山之计，小老二佩服的紧！“他背对竹屋，声音经玄力激荡而去，“我中你计一次，岂有再中之理？“
“你无非是想等我离开，再折回收尸。我偏不让你如愿。“
随即老丑开始摆弄马元庆尸身，将银针扎遍尸身眉心、膻中、丹田等各大要穴。嘴中念念有词。
好一会才道：“你只需将我的女人还我。如若不然，我便将你父炼化为尸傀，从今往后，永不得超生！“
开出这个条件，老丑心里清楚，对方绝对不会答应。
说这些，只为确认马映雪是否在附近，借此判断方位，将其找出。
话语落，山林寂静，只有山风吹拂。
老丑又继续喊话道：“马映雪，你还在考虑吗？我与你们本无仇怨，此番皆因那女人而起。不然，也不会有如此遭遇！“
“不过现在事已经发生，总是要有一个了结的！“老丑喋喋不休道。
然后又是好一番掐诀念咒。仿佛是在做最后的操控。
忽地老丑猛喝一声：“马映雪，你哪里走！”随即转身运转玄功向林中打出一掌。

但见竹林炸开，鸟兽飞走，却并无一人。
“咦？”老丑不免心生挫折。本想投石问路，诈她一诈，看来此番又落空了。
十几息后。依旧无动静。仿佛老丑一个人在演独角戏。
“马映雪，你可真够狠的。“老丑轻叹。
此刻来看，是老丑赌输了。马映雪并不在附近，或者一直隐藏在暗处，带着夜璇，并不现身。
老丑随即破口大骂道：“我艹尼玛，马映雪！算你狠！寻人求援是吧，好好好！老子不陪你玩了！“
说罢，打了个火折，丢在房屋边缘，确认太初圣地方向，身形几个起落消失在山林之中。
此刻他是真的疾行了两里。但绕回却是更快，反正已经“暴露“了，不如让马映雪以为他真的逃走了。再杀她个回马枪。也好叫她知晓姜还是老的辣！
很快回到竹屋附近的密林暗处，调息打坐。
此前与夜璇合交，纯阳体非但不累，混元无极功反添精益。寒气渐消。
虚虚实实，真真假假。他不信马映雪已带人离开。
他与马映雪之间的互赌，仍未结束。
以他推测，夜璇应该还是没有走远。她现在身体不允许长途跋涉，若马映雪带其离开，势必要冒着被追赶上的可能。
所以，马映雪故技重施的可能性极大。
看着慢慢燃起的熊熊烈火，她父亲尸首在此，不信她会完全无动于衷！

Chapter 10: I fell into the trap and burned your father’s corpse (page 1)
The old man didn't care about his internal injuries, so he used all his Qinggong skills and hurried back to the cabin.
The old Chou slapped his thigh: "You were careless, you were careless. I didn't expect that I was tricked by a little girl today!"
Then he sneered at himself: "Ma Yingxue, you really surprised me. You are so smart."
Lao Chou speculated that Ma Yingxue could not go far with one person. Now is the last chance to catch up!
Walk out of the bamboo house and look around. After taking a few steps, he felt something was wrong and frowned slightly.
There is no clue at the moment. How can we catch up with him from all directions?
"Ma Yingxue, you have a plan to lure the tiger away from the mountain. The little boy is very impressed!" He turned his back to the bamboo house, his voice was stirred by the mysterious force, "I fell into your trap once, how can I fall into it again?"
"You just want to wait for me to leave and then recycle the corpse. I won't let you do that."
Immediately, the old man began to play with Ma Yuanqing's body, pricking silver needles all over the body's major points such as the eyebrows, tanzhong, and Dantian. There are words in his mouth.
After a while, he said: "You only need to give me my woman back. If not, I will refine your father into a corpse puppet. From now on, he will never be reincarnated!"
After making this offer, Lao Chou knew in his heart that the other party would never agree.
I say all this just to confirm whether Ma Yingxue is nearby, so as to determine the direction and find it.
After the words fell, the mountains and forests were silent, with only the mountain breeze blowing.
Lao Chou continued to shout: "Ma Yingxue, are you still thinking about it? I have no grudges with you at all. This happened all because of that woman. Otherwise, we wouldn't have suffered like this!"
"But now that things have happened, there must be an end to it!" the old man chattered.
Then there was another round of kneading and chanting. It seems to be making the final manipulation.
Suddenly Lao Chou shouted loudly: "Ma Yingxue, where are you going!" Then he turned around and used Xuan Gong to strike into the forest.
But the bamboo forest exploded and birds and animals flew away, but no one was there.
"Huh?" The old man couldn't help but feel frustrated. I wanted to ask for directions and deceive her, but it seems that this time I failed again.
After more than ten breaths. Still no movement. It was as if the old man was performing a one-man show.
"Ma Yingxue, you are so cruel." Lao Chou sighed.
At this moment, it seems that Lao Chou lost the bet. Ma Yingxue was not nearby, or had been hiding in the dark, taking Ye Xuan with her and not showing up.
Lao Chou immediately yelled, "Fuck you, Ma Yingxue! You're so cruel! I'm looking for help, right? OK, OK! I won't play with you anymore!"
After that, he burned it and threw it on the edge of the house. After confirming the direction of the Holy Land of Taichu, his body rose and fell and disappeared into the forest.
At this moment, he really traveled two miles quickly. But it was faster to circle back. He had been "exposed" anyway, so it was better to let Ma Yingxue think that he had really escaped. Kill her again. It also helps her know that old age is still hotter!
Soon I returned to the darkness of the dense forest near the bamboo house, and meditated while adjusting my breath.
After having sex with Ye Xuan before, not only was the pure Yang body not tired, but the Hunyuan Wuji Kung was even more lean. The cold is fading.
False and false, true and false. He didn't believe that Ma Yingxue had taken people away.
The bet between him and Ma Yingxue is not over yet.
Based on his speculation, Ye Xuan probably hasn't gone far yet. She is not physically allowed to travel long distances now. If Ma Yingxue takes her away, she will risk being caught up.
Therefore, it is highly possible for Ma Yingxue to repeat her old tricks.
Looking at the raging fire slowly burning, her father's body is here, I don't believe she will be completely indifferent!
